Name: Great Ravine Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Map has:
Diggable Grass
Mountain Fish
Forest Forageables
Respawning Stumps
A Large open Space for Farming
Bunch of River islands
Large Custom Cave with Ore Spawns, Which you can Build Buildings in and use Casks In.

And it is a Custom Farm Map, not a replacer.

If you notice a bug, please let me know so I can fix it.

Downloads.Description: If I messed up something or you notice an error, please tell me. I'm brushing off the ol' Modding Rust.

Manifest.Name: Great Ravine Farm
Manifest.Description: A Large Map with some wide open spaces, a Forest Area with forage and respawning stumps, a bunch of river islands, and a Large Cave With ore. (Separate from the Farm Cave).
